label: PROSPECTIVE (post-registration; not part of PREREGISTRATION.md)

training.leakage_assertion: zero Keller-training molecules share a CID or canonical stereo-stripped SMILES with any Ma or pool.csv molecule

conformal.calibration_model: the same model as the predictions (trained without every Ma and pool molecule)
conformal.score: |ECDF(observed; cal observed) - ECDF(predicted; cal predicted)|, mid-rank, exactly exploratory.py
conformal.call_rule: liked: lower > threshold; disliked: upper <= threshold; else abstain

settings.mixture_rule: equal-weight mean of component rank-scale values
settings.pair_rule: unordered pairs of eligible pool molecules, at least one role == cocoa_key

selection.quintile_definition: rank by ensemble prediction (ties by pair_id), position*5//n
selection.greedy: round-robin over quintiles; each pick minimises summed prior uses of its two molecules, then maximises 1 - ECFP4 Tanimoto of the pair, then pair_id
selection.anchor_rule: mixture nearest the median observed value of the quintile, both components purchasable preferred
selection.purchasable: pool row with exclusion_reason == 'in Ma 2021 data set (test data)'

interpretations: Step 3 'a model with Ma molecules excluded but otherwise the same as in step 1' read as the step-1 model itself, which already excludes every Ma molecule; calibration and prediction share one model.
Anchors are scored by the same model with their conformal call computed on the calibration scale; they are in the calibration set, so their intervals are in-sample.
Anchor 'eligible-for-purchase' = in pool.csv and excluded solely for being a Ma test molecule (myrcene, FDA-delisted, is therefore not purchasable).
